visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation opens with a stark black background divided by a thick white horizontal bar across the center third of the frame. A chubby, stylized yellow and white cartoon cat slowly peeks its head over the white bar. The cat has its eyes tightly closed in a satisfied smile, with small white paws resting on the edge of the bar. (2) A small black and red traditional hat suddenly appears on the cat's head. Simultaneously, a thought bubble manifests above its head, containing two icons of cat food cans, one yellow and one blue. The cat's eyes snap wide open into large circles with small pupils, its mouth forming a shocked 'o' shape. (3) The cat maintains its position peeking over the bar, but its facial expression transforms into a grumpy or unimpressed look. Its eyes become half-lidded with flat upper lids, and its small pink nose and mouth set into a neutral, slightly annoyed line while it remains perfectly still against the white background. (4) The cat abruptly rotates its body 180 degrees, presenting its round, yellow-furred backside and short tail to the viewer. It performs a small wiggling motion with its hips against the white background bar before the animation sequence concludes and the cat disappears from the frame entirely, leaving the bar empty.
